request.observation: Poor ventilation and high CO readings

analysis.reasoning: Statutory evaluation under CMR 2017, Regulation 153 (Ventilation & Inflammable Gas Monitoring) classifies this observation as MEDIUM severity with an evaluated risk score of 55/100. Immediate operational risks involve potential hazard escalation affecting workforce safety and machinery operational continuity.
analysis.recommended_action:
1. Issue standard statutory compliance notice to site supervisor.
2. Complete scheduled maintenance/remediation within 7 business days.
3. Submit photographic compliance proof for safety officer verification.
analysis.summary: Identified ventilation & mine gas safety non-conformance during Safety Audit at Gevra OC Mine: Poor ventilation and high CO readings in incline shaft 2.
